0022600217.text: Washington (4-7, 10th in the East, 2-5 on the road) has lost four straight and visits Indiana (3-8, 11th in the East, 0-5 at home, losing two in a row) for the Wizards' 12th game of the season. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell is day-to-day with a hamstring issue and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20, 2026.
